lines: The mold is empty until something enters it. Then every contour becomes consequential.
One Person. Knowledge speaks, protection holds, exchange circulates, skilled work carries the weight.
The cavity holds the movement. The value-orbit gives it somewhere to return.

shots.title: The cavity receives
shots.prompt_origin: original article-specific composition using common assembly template

generation_settings.prompt: Eight-second 16:9 single continuous cinematic shot. The supplied start image defines the exact bronze sculpture, porous terracotta mold, recessed oval chest ribs and engraved channels. Preserve all visible geometry, two arms and two legs where visible, head toward image left and feet toward image right. Tactile architectural miniature cinematography: internally luminous warm Sacred Gold #C5A017, Void Black #070B1D surroundings, restrained Witness Violet #2D0050 shadows. No cuts, humans, anatomy changes, new channels, lettering, symbols, halos, laser beams or decorative particles. Keep the rigid statue and mold completely still. MACRO CHEST. One narrow continuous molten-gold stream pours from the existing ceramic spout into the empty nested oval chest cavity. 0–1s poised, 1–6s slowly fill the existing recessed cavities, 6–8s stop the stream and let contained gold settle into a steady glow. Very slow overhead push-in. Preserve rib count and contour visible in reference, never melt the bronze. No splash outside cavity. Subtle liquid trickle and ceramic room resonance only, no speech, chanting or music.

review.notes: Pour fills the chest cavity and settles; nested ribs become covered by the pool as it fills. No visible text or anatomy change in sampled frames.

reference_review.observation: Empty dark chest cavity, ceramic spout poised, head-left torso close-up; rib count needs manual confirmation before exact five-sheath diagram use.

Start with all channels lit and the single brighter gold bead at the right chest junction visible in reference. If a junction is ambiguous, follow the visible connecting groove without creating a new path. Single slow overhead pullback, whole figure stays readable. Bead does not split, statue does not move.
